string.name: player_toast_menu_hint
string.value: Tap the menu button at the top center for sound, recording, the controller, picture-in-picture and more; to stop, tap the exit button at the top right of the menu

string.name: tv_guide_body
string.value:
Menu key, or hold OK: open or close the menu
Arrow keys: move in the menu; OK: select
Back: up one level, then close the menu; with the menu closed, Back ends the stream and returns home
With a controller: hold Start and Select (+ and −) for 1.5 seconds to open the menu

string.name: pic_edit_hint
string.value: Drag the picture up or down; it snaps to the top, center and bottom. The buttons stay where they are; move them with "Arrange buttons"

string.name: pic_pos_saved

string.name: player_exit_rec_message
string.value: Stop recording and leave? Keep recording moves on to Record only: no picture, and the recording goes on.
